summary: Verdict: escalate (confidence 0.65). F3: one Turkcell (TR) sign-in outside the account baseline is confirmed, consistent with T1078.004 valid account use. F2: ten sign-ins from Portugal via vpn-edge-02 on LT-3104 are likely baseline activity. Rejected impossible-travel, password-spray, and VPN-KEV claims lack sufficient evidence.

risk.rationale: All suspicious signals are explained away by verified critics, with no data-quality conflicts. F3 (confirmed 0.75 Turkcell TR ASN sign-in, T1078.004) is a non-interactive ExchangeSync/15 mail-sync token, not an interactive human login, so it does not constitute account takeover. F2 (likely 0.5, PT sign-ins) uses university VPN vpn-edge-02 from known device LT-3104. The password-spray claim is rejected because 193.140.10.21 is shared egress with 201 distinct MFA completions in 30 days (failures are background noise). The VPN appliance KEV claim is rejected because firmware 22.7R2.8 includes the relevant fixes. No confirmed account takeover chain; suspicious signals explained away → benign.
